industryUsage.description:
The reason for the amount update. Possible values: 
* **delayedCharge** 
* **noShow** 
* **installment**

lineItems.description:
Price and product information of the refunded items, required for [partial refunds](https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments/refund#refund-a-payment).
> This field is required for partial refunds with 3x 4x Oney, Affirm, Afterpay, Atome, Clearpay, Klarna, Ratepay, Walley, and Zip.

merchantAccount.description: The merchant account that is used to process the payment.

paymentPspReference.description: The [`pspReference`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/CheckoutService/latest/post/payments__resParam_pspReference) of the payment to update.

pspReference.description: Adyen's 16-character reference associated with the amount update request.

reference.description: Your reference for the amount update request. Maximum length: 80 characters.

splits.description: An array of objects specifying how the amount should be split between accounts when using Adyen for Platforms. For details, refer to [Providing split information](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/processing-payments#providing-split-information).

status.description: The status of your request. This will always have the value **received**.

value.description: The amount of the transaction, in [minor units](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes).

amountExcludingTax.description: Item amount excluding the tax, in minor units.

amountIncludingTax.description: Item amount including the tax, in minor units.

imageUrl.description: Link to the picture of the purchased item.

itemCategory.description: Item category, used by the payment methods PayPal and Ratepay.

receiverEmail.description: Email associated with the given product in the basket (usually in electronic gift cards).

account.description:
The unique identifier of the account to which the split amount is booked. Required if `type` is **MarketPlace** or **BalanceAccount**.

* [Classic Platforms integration](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/classic): The [`accountCode`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Account/latest/post/updateAccount#request-accountCode) of the account to which the split amount is booked.
* [Balance Platform](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms): The [`balanceAccountId`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/balanceplatform/latest/get/balanceAccounts/_id_#path-id) of the account to which the split amount is booked.

amount.description:
The amount of the split item.

* Required for all split types in the [Classic Platforms integration](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/classic).
* Required if `type` is **BalanceAccount**, **Commission**, **Default**, or **VAT** in your [Balance Platform](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms) integration.

description.description: Your description for the split item.

reference.description:
Your unique reference for the split item.

This is required if `type` is **MarketPlace** ([Classic Platforms integration](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/classic)) or **BalanceAccount** ([Balance Platform](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms)).

For the other types, we also recommend providing a **unique** reference so you can reconcile the split and the associated payment in the transaction overview and in the reports.

type.description:
The type of the split item.

Possible values:

* [Classic Platforms integration](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/classic): **Commission**, **Default**, **Marketplace**, **PaymentFee**, **VAT**.
* [Balance Platform](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms): **BalanceAccount**, **Commission**, **Default**, **PaymentFee**, **Remainder**, **Surcharge**, **Tip**, **VAT**.

currency.description: The three-character [ISO currency code](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes). By default, this is the original payment currency.

value.description: The value of the split amount, in [minor units](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes).
